description: [roadmap S3.1] GlRaster misses the G2 criterion on 16 of the 28 draw-list passes of recording g6 (cov_b_paths, tiles fuzzed with 60 % type 7 and a non-hidden border column, view angle 90): one-level pixels 1.56 .. 2.47 % of the drawn (limit 1.5 %) on 13 stripRender / localRender passes, 108 .. 145 pixels more than one level off on 3 (limit 70). Replaying the ORIGINAL's recorded stream through GlRaster gives the same numbers (i012_raised_strip 4,421 one-level / 5 big; i005_raised_pathupd 1,142 / 145), and the port's stream equals the original's line for line on all 28, so the miss is the rasteriser's on that state, not the renderer's. Split (log/roadmap/S3/1_g6_diag.py): i012 opaque 3,958 of 4,421 one-level pixels; i005 blended 127 of 145 big pixels; the same strip pass on the lightly fuzzed g5 state (5 % type 7) has 627 opaque one-level pixels. 81 of i012's 1,374 binds name texture 0 (incomplete: drawn untextured). Not measured: which triangles (rotated type-7 textures, untextured lit colour, blended path bands over them) carry the errors. The g6 raster tests are xfail (non-strict) in port/test/test_terrain_render.py. | Per-triangle error map of g6/i012 and g6/i005 (sg_raster_get_tri_ids + the pass's bind / glBegin sequence), then a probe of the generic GL on untextured lit triangles and on blended bands at angle 90. | open

[roadmap S3.1] A draw-list pass that calls no glArrayElement leaves no snapshot (gl_rec.js keeps a pass only when maxIdx >= 0), so the passes that draw no tile are not judged: stripRender with a direction outside 1..8 (injected as 9 in every set: no snapshot), directions 2 / 3 / 4 at zoom shift 2 around the g4 pivot, and pathUpdateRender in two of g2's three injection groups (sequence numbers 15..19 and 29..33: no tile drawn, why not read). For them the port emits the frame only (glLoadIdentity, glPushMatrix, glRotated, glRotatef, glTranslatef when the pivot is non-NULL, glPopMatrix, glFlush, and for an odd direction the two nested frames), read from re/match/terrain_strip.cpp / terrain_pathrender.cpp, not compared with a recording. | Let gl_rec.js keep a pass with maxIdx < 0 when it was injected (no arrays to copy) and compare those streams. | open

[roadmap S3.1] pathUpdateRender clips its left edge to x + 1 (`left = pivot->getX() + 1` when x < 15 << zoom; the other three edges clip to the grid), so it walks column x = 0 where the other edges stop at the grid. The difference shows only on a non-hidden tile with a path in column 0: in 608 of the 681 Terrain objects of port/corpus (gl and terrain) the whole column 0 is type 0x14 (hidden); the others are construction-time states (type 4 before the course's setType calls) or fuzzed ones. So the quirk is unobservable in every recorded game state; control 12 reads RED only on the constructed g6 state (6 passes). Whether a game state with a non-hidden border column exists was not read from the exe's course code. | Read where the exe writes the border ring's type (rebuildTerrainGrid / generateRandomCourse) to settle whether column 0 can ever be non-hidden. | open

[roadmap S3.1] localRender asserts pTile != NULL before its first GL call (the debug build's assert, re/match/terrain_localrender.cpp: base line + 3); the port throws a Fault there instead of the CRT's assert report. No recording or exe caller passes NULL (updateTerrainRender passes the list's tiles). pathUpdateRender and stripRender read a NULL pivot after their GL frame and fault there in the port as in the original's code order; also never recorded. | A Terrain-boundary caller that can pass NULL, or none (then nothing to do). | open

[roadmap S3.1] The G2 check is vacuous on four kind-3 passes: c3 hole, c5 hole_local and c6 hole_local draw 0 pixels in GlRaster (their 25 tiles are off the viewport around the translated pivot) and the original changed none (dib_pre = dib_post); their streams are still compared line for line. 14 of the other 17 kind-3 passes redraw unchanged tiles over an identical frame (changed 0 pixels), so their G2 compares the redraw with the earlier full frame's pixels. | A localRender recorded right after a state change of its tiles (an edit), where dib_pre and dib_post differ (c4's five passes are those: 465 .. 506 pixels changed). | open
